name: Solid-state qubits
blurb: Spins and superconducting circuits — the gates, the readout, and the noise that limits them.

touchstones.text: exchange gates and two-qubit operations in semiconductor double quantum dots
transmon and fluxonium coherence, single- and two-qubit gate fidelity
charge noise, dephasing and 1/f noise in Si/SiGe and GaAs devices
circuit QED dispersive readout and Purcell-limited measurement
spin readout: Pauli spin blockade, latched and dispersive schemes
materials-limited loss: two-level systems, interfaces, valley splitting
scaling up: crossbar addressing, cryo-CMOS control, qubit interconnects
